ink.$description: Headings, axes, essential body copy, and primary labels.

construct.$description: Geometric objects, curves, principal mathematical terms, and persistent markers.

active.$description: The single relation currently being explained; never general decoration.

compare.$description: A secondary representation or preceding state used for comparison.

muted.$description: Dimensions, secondary notes, axis values, and non-essential metadata.

grid.$description: Dividers and coordinate grids only; never mathematical data.

display.$description: Headings, body copy, captions, and short explanations.

math.$description: Variables, expressions, equations, coordinates, and mathematical labels.

label.$description: Chapter metadata, view names, and short semantic annotations.

enter.$description: Arrival of a heading, label, or symbolic term.

construct.$description: Construction of a geometric segment, boundary, or dimension.

trace.$description: Tracing a function or moving along a meaningful path.

connect.$description: Drawing a proofline and landing its endpoint.

transform.$description: A continuous mathematical change or transformation.

settle.$description: The final settling motion before a narration-led hold.

transform.$description: Symmetric acceleration and deceleration for mathematical changes.

leave.$description: A restrained exit when an element must leave.
